provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Falthrakar is centered at 32.804753, -5.451203 under Diarchy, with 118,613,000 people across 11 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Falthrakar occupies 6,829,353.14 sq mi / 17,687,943.45 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.467776% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Partial forest, Beach and grass with water and Marshes and swamps define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Grassland, Marshes and swamps and Farming. Population density is 6.706 people/sq km / 17.368 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Fey and Trickster Folk, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie, Satyr, Changeling, Harengon, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Crucible Wardens, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Marduthor, Setrimir, Sigrananna, Iskareth, Thalunesh, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 12 recorded four-province geography group links, including 10 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Cyrille Bellwisp
npcs.description:
Cyrille Bellwisp is unfailingly polite, curious, gentle, and clinically fearless, with a scholar’s delight in dreadful things that makes them seem naïve even when she is standing in the middle of horror. As a Geppettin, Cyrille is one of Setrimir’s constructed peoples: artisan-crafted, socially expressive, purpose-built for specialized labor, and shaped by the strange dignity of artificial life trying to become more than its original function.
At the Ichor-Regulated Medical Office, Cyrille studies infection, divine residue, addiction damage, black-market ichor poisoning, and long-term exposure to contaminated god-prison byproducts. Their work with the Regent Lattice makes her a physician, archivist, and sealed-laboratory custodian in Lithvar’s underdeep medical network, where she is eager to help patients but sometimes dangerously slow to recognize when “valuable research” began as someone else’s cruelty.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Lithvar is a City in Falthrakar, under Diarchy, with severe danger, Beach and grass with water, Marshes and swamps, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Dril'thar — Marsh, Dril'thar — Swamp, Dril'thar — Rainforest. Geppettin reads through the Geppettin entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Artisan-crafted puppetfolk animated through intricate enchantment and craftsmanship. They are expressive and social, often mirroring the personalities of their creators. Table cues: Darkvision, Construct Nature, Handcrafted Quality, Gepettin Construction; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Cyrille Bellwisp knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Nebday.
Cyrille Bellwisp has a contact in Sylthadös who will deny everything.

A rival faction offers proof that Cyrille Bellwisp's public story is incomplete.
